technical_and_design_decisions: Implementation will be written in Go, extending the existing Hyperledger Fabric channel configuration library (fabric-config).
Protobuf-derived data structures (such as common.Config, FabricMSPConfig, Organization, and Policy) will be used directly or wrapped in domain helper structures.
Policy addition/removal methods for Application, Orderer, and Consortium groups/orgs will follow consistent mutation patterns returning updated config representations.

Certificate revocation (U8) will parse x509 certificates and validate the target certificate signature against the MSP's root/intermediate CA certificates before appending to the RevocationList attribute.
assumptions: Development is performed by a single software engineer familiar with Go and Hyperledger Fabric channel configuration structures.
Existing fabric-config codebase, build scripts, linting tools, and CI pipeline are available and functional.
Protobuf definitions for MSP and Channel configuration are already generated and stable in the codebase.

activities.activity_description: Analyze existing fabric-config API patterns and design public helper functions and data structures for U1 through U8.
Implement helper functions to extract config.Organization from application, orderer, or consortium configurations within a channel configuration transaction.

activities.activity_name: Implement Policy Management APIs (U2, U3, U4)
activities.activity_description: Implement functions to add and remove policies for Application orgs/groups, Orderer orgs/groups, and Consortium orgs/groups.
Implement helper functions to add new Orderer and Application Organization definitions to a channel configuration transaction.
Implement helper function to extract MSP configuration for a specified organization from channel configuration transactions.
Implement certificate revocation helper that validates x509 cert issuance against MSP CA certs and updates FabricMSPConfig revocation_list, returning errors for unissued certificates.

activities.activity_name: Example Tests & Unit Test Suite Updates
activities.activity_description: Create and update example tests (`example_test.go`) and comprehensive unit tests for all new helper functions demonstrating usage for U1-U8.
Add Godoc comments for all exported APIs, format code, run linter, and perform final code self-review.
